notes.title: A Taste of Greece Update | Greek DLC, Customer Reaction Emojis and Fixes [1.11]
notes.content:

notes.title: Version 1.7 | Food Gets Cold, Christmas Event & Improvements!
notes.content:
[h2]FOOD GETS COLD![/h2]

As highly recommended by. multiple people, hot food & drink now cools down after it's been cooked/poured, bringing a greater focus to serving food efficiently and making use of appliances like the Plate Warmer! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/f28171cfbbe206d5ba45727f2a4fa645884b372b.png[/img]

[h3]Customer Rating Effect[/h3]

If you serve a customer cold food they will leave a pretty large negative rating for your food truck. 

[i]Keep in mind that any effect that influencers and critics give you are multiplied whether they're positive or negative![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/1ec628ea67190a245c03a5f10d7239d05871ad31.png[/img]

[h3]Tips[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Try to plan ahead by previewing what the customer will order by hovering your mouse over them in the queue.
[*] Get yourself the plate warmer and place hot food & drink on it to keep it warm whilst you prep everything else.
[*] Leave your items to cook that little bit longer to give yourself more time to get the other items ready, just make sure you don't let it burn!
[*] Leave jacket potatoes in the oven! The potato oven keeps the potatoes perfectly warm and they won't cool down or burn.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/28640af1395d4d62fc3f78e5ddc378639d6261e2.png[/img]


[h2]CHRISTMAS EVENT[/h2]

Who doesn't love Christmas? The local residents of Chestnut Ridge certainly do! Every location has seen plenty of snowfall and the locals have been out building snowmen, placing Christmas Trees and hiding presents, can you find them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/12474186333f732e4325c8a7521448cc2a89220d.png[/img]


[h2]MAIN IMPROVEMENTS & FIXES[/h2]

This update. brings an extensive list of fixes to make your experience bug free and more fun! Some of the main fixes include:

[list]
[*] The menu now shows locked items correctly.
[*] Tooltips no longer trail off the edge of the screen.
[*] The player will now spawn inside the Snack Shack at the Aspen Office District.
[*] Fixed some customers getting stuck at the end of the queue.
[*] Fixed missing SFX.
[*] Fixed some UI bugs.
[/list]

If you find any more bugs, please let me know either on our [url=https://discord.gg/eMVsRU7PdF]Discord[/url] server or on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2733690/discussions/0/]Steam Forums[/url], and I'll look into it ASAP!


Happy Grubbing!

notes.title: Version 1.6 | New Menu, Attach Objects & Pumpkin Pie!
notes.content:
[h2]NEW MENU[/h2]

As highly requested, 1.6 brings you a brand new menu that is much easier to use!

[h3]Drag & Drop[/h3]

The old, ugly dropdown system has gone! Say hello to the new drag and drop menu system. Simply chose the slot you want to modify, drag your chosen item into the slot and set your price!

[i]You can change, remove and modify the price of your menu items at any time.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/30eeacd603c7a00f2078ced1da2b5d746e378961.gif[/img]

[h3]Unlockable Slots[/h3]

You can now unlock more menu item slots the more experience you gain as a Grub Truck chef. Ontop of this, there are now a lot more slots available to occupy with menu items, allowing you to have complete control over your menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/8c23beb7a5888bef7c19abc8527274c31e44a200.gif[/img]

[h3]Menu Navigation[/h3]

Not only does the new menu just look 1000% better (accurate statistic), it is also much easier to navigate, with the whole menu being scrollable, quick action buttons taking you to parts of the menu and all menu slots showing you the icon, name and set price of each slot within a single box!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/f78dd78608bd8569df0d66647c5318227e3cb3bc.gif[/img]


[h2]ATTACHED OBJECTS MOVE TOGETHER![/h2]

As the title suggests, objects now attached to each other and can be moved together, so you will no longer have to worry about the concerning floating knife block that was ontop of the fridge!

[i]Note: In order to get previously placed objects to become attached, you will need to move them in Build Mode.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/b503b0bccd733fdbcf13989f732b64f010db3145.gif[/img]


[h2]NEW MAIN MENU ITEM![/h2]

Halloween is quickly approaching, and to celebrate, here's a spooky main to add to your menu: The Pumpkin Pie!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/549b0a44b796c64d4a4c7f371de826a7b09e77bc.png[/img]


[h2]MINI FRIDGE![/h2]

You can now get a mini fridge that doesn't store much, but it can be hung on walls, give you optimal floor space for your Grub Truck! There is also a new sauce box variant to add some variety to your trucks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/f8008013df995417a33ca78b792436f50aac2f65.png[/img]


[h2]2 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS![/h2]

For you achievement hunters out there, there has been two new achievements added: Size Matters & Queue-tastrophe!


Happy Grubbing!



[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completed New Menu System [New UI, New Limits, Improved Efficiency]
[*] Attached Objects now move together!
[*] New Main Item: Pumpkin Pie!
[*] New Build Mode Items! - Frostbite Mini Fridge & Sauce Box Variant [Handle]
[*] 2 New Achievements! - Size Matters & Queue-tastrophe
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed fridges sometimes not opening when a player gets close enough
[*] Fixed some objects not being easy to interact with
[*] Removed unused script references on some UI objects
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.5 | Manager Improvements, Simulator Radio, Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]MANAGER IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

The long awaited improvements to managers is finally here! Here's a brief look at what's changed!

[h3]Manager Budgets[/h3]

You can now assign budgets to managers for them to buy stock with. You can also toggle whether they can use your personal stock to save money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/d79c19ebdfc17044e9fcb1b16b1a7fb9f0dea400.png[/img]

[h3]Manager Locations & Signature Dishes[/h3]

You can now assign locations to each manager and their truck. This also means that things such as signature dishes and location business now all effect every manager.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/6bd58e8541e33f5c3f95d63126a3075cda12a77a.png[/img]

[h3]Manager Reports[/h3]

You can now see a breakdown of each truck's info including stats such as: appliance count, average appliance level, whether the signature dish is correct, the manager's wage, the average menu price etc. Most importantly, you can now see a breakdown of what the manager has sold in the previous day, displaying how much income they made and how much they spent on stock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/57d3a0657baa2bdc41bf35384a29ab69003beb78.png[/img]


[h2]SIMULATOR RADIO[/h2]

I'm super excited about this one! 

We've teamed up with [url=https://simulatorradio.com/home]SimuatlorRadio[/url] (the team behind the radio in games like Euro Truck Simulator & Farming Simulator), to bring you live music through the HelixHarmony Radio object, which can be placed anywhere in your truck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/10e8b72cf4ffc1a1c26f5c70c173fd05c3755484.png[/img]


[h2]PREVIEW CUSTOMER ORDERS[/h2]

As suggested by you guys, you can now preview the orders of customers in your queue. Simply hover your mouse over a customer to see what they are likely to order. The higher your level, the more items you can see in the order bubble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/1de249f446a89cf330951e1b0ff171c4a9b7c08f.png[/img]


[h2]NEW TRUCK[/h2]

There's a new truck in town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/3bac2671bdd4e71d9325d23969c94ee645f76203.png[/img]


[h2]2 NEW CUSTOMERS & 2 NEW MANAGERS[/h2]

2 new residents have moved into Chestnut Ridge! Say hello to the Lawyers. They may be quite picky in what they order and will only turn up in the more built up locations, but they're sure to spend more money than most!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/9480906507a76b885ca27fc61962d84e782dcaa7.png[/img]

Thanks to the two winners of the August 2024 Manager Competition, there are 2 new managers available! Hire Timothée Chowmein or Hans Grubber today! 

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/eMVsRU7PdF]Discord[/url] server to get involved in future competitions! 
[url=https://discord.gg/eMVsRU7PdF]https://discord.gg/eMVsRU7PdF[/url]

Along with this update, there's been a tutorial added explaining how to use managers, manager profits have been added to the end of day receipt for a speedier viewing & customer lose patience if you make mistakes in their order if it is later on in the day. Ontop of this, there's been a bunch of fixes and a lot of changes/improvements such as truck storage being collated all into one.

Happy Grubbing!

notes.title: Version 1.0 | Managers, Events, New Customers, New Items & More!
notes.content:
[h1]VERSION 1.0[/h1]

Version 1.0 is here!! Packed with new gameplay features, build mode items, fixes and improvements!


[h2]MANAGERS[/h2]

Earn some passive income with the new Grub Truck managers!

[h3]Candidates[/h3]

On the map screen, you can view the Recruitment Agency (button on the right) and see your collection of potential candidates. These candidates have different rarities (common, uncommon, rare, epic & legendary).

You can view what their wage would be as well as how much profit they are expected to make.

Once you choose who want, click hire and they will go into the 'Your Staff' panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/7cc26392a7d40c4fbc5e068eb0ee18c09b25926b.png[/img]

[h3]Assigning Managers[/h3]

Now you have a manager in your team, open up your garage and press the face icon on the truck you want to assign them to. From here, using the dropdown and select your newly recruited manager.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/8616423aba76d10358c33ad5378473a99c3a44c4.png[/img]

[h3]Manager Earnings[/h3]

At the end of each day you will see a break down of how much money each manager made as well as their wage. Make sure that truck you assign a manager to has the basic appliances to effectively run the Grub Truck for you!

[h3]V0.8.9 Changelog[/h3]
For those who tried the previous versions on itch, here's what changed since the most recent version!

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Weather! ↓
[*] Clear/Sunny - x1 customer spawn chance
[*] Overcast - x0.75 customer spawn chance
[*] Overcast/Rainy - x0.25 customer spawn chance
[*] Thunderstorm - x0.05 customer spawn chance
[*] You can now Shift click on the stock screen to add/deduct 10 at a time
[*] You can now Control click on the stock screen to add/deduct 50 at a time
[*] You can now enter and exit Build Mode with the Hot Key ‘TAB’
[*] You can now exit stations using ‘ESC’
[*] You can now exit the Stock Shop, Finance Screen and Menu Editor with ‘ESC’ or ‘TAB’
[*] Added ‘Loan payments are taken at the end of each day’ to the finances tutorial
[*] Your Camera position and rotation is now saved when changing between stations and returning (including birds eye mode)
[*] Added a subway entrance to the Aspen Office District
[*] Added a perimeter fence to Bonsai Bay
[*] The clock now turns red, expands and makes a ticking SFX as it reaches 20:00 to signify the end of the day approaching
[*] Further MapScreen improvements/additions
[*] The sea is now animated
[*] More misc details
[*] More terrain textures
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Stock Menu “+1” labels are now reset when refreshing the stock or purchasing an order
[*] Fixed loan buttons not showing values
[*] Fixed magic (floating) cup
[*] Fixed spacebar serving counter spam
[*] Fixed the broken drinks dispenser
[*] Fixed the infinite shelf glitch (you can no longer place shelves on shelves)
[*] Fixed incorrect loading progress for some tutorials
[*] Fixed missing textures on some truck model menus
[*] Fixed fridge close SFX when leaving other stations
[*] The camera no longer gets stuck when entering Build Mode from the Birds Eye perspective
[/list]

[/list]
